summary: ADT Inc. via its subsidiaries entered into an incremental term loan amendment, borrowing $100 million in first-lien senior secured term A loans. This increases outstanding term A loans to $520.31 million. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation, as it lacks transformative elements like acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring. It is an ordinary credit facility amendment and incremental borrowing, so it does not meet special-situation classification criteria.
